# Port parser contract

parsePort accepts a number or a string containing only decimal digits. It returns an integer from 1 through 65535. Non-number/non-string inputs and strings containing signs, spaces, decimals, or other characters throw TypeError. Numeric values outside 1 through 65535, including fractions, throw RangeError.

modes: code

Wrong types or strings with signs, whitespace, decimals, or letters throw TypeError. Numeric values outside the valid range or fractions throw RangeError. Preserve these distinct error classes.
